NFC stands for Near Field Communication. Compatible devices can exchange small amounts of information when they are very close together. For Dbizcard, an NFC tag points visitors to your published digital card.
Hardware and browser support varies. Locking a tag may make it permanently read-only; do so only if you understand that consequence. Dbizcard does not perform universal browser-based NFC writing.
